enunciado: Implement SortedList whose insertSorted(v) operation puts each value in its place so the list is always sorted. Insert 42, 7, 19, 3, 42, 25, 1 showing the list after each insertion.
objetivos: Maintain an ordering invariant in a linked structure
Insert in the middle of a list
pistas: Find the first node whose value is larger than v.
Insert before it: you need the previous node.
Inserting at the front is a special case.
